battle.name: 北圻遠征
battle.theater: 北圻河內與紅河三角洲
battle.brief: 一八八三年五月，法軍遠征隊自海防與西貢沿紅河北上，在紙橋與北黎兩戰先後被黑旗軍擊敗，遠征軍司令里維耶陣亡。法國於是傾力增兵，改以野戰砲封鎖與攻城術取代縱隊冒進，一八八四年連下北寧與河內城砦，一八八六年北圻正式編為法國殖民地。雷管步槍射程雖長，卻輸在射速。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是法國與北圻的阮朝朝廷及受僱於此的黑旗軍，戰事升溫後更捲入中國廣西與雲南的官軍。法國方面，遠征北圻的部隊分三層編成：最上層是巴黎的殖民部與陸軍部共同掌握的人事與補給權，遠征軍總司令先後由布里耶·德·伊爾、法伊利、加利尼三人接任，海軍方面由北圻分艦司令康貝海軍上將統率艦隊與江上砲艇群。部隊骨幹是法國本土步兵團與外籍營，另有阿爾及利亞殖民步兵「土兵」與安南人徵召的民兵，砲兵配備速射野戰砲與攻城重砲，後勤以海防、西貢與河內三處基地轉運，腹地的南圻與安南供應糧秣與船隻。另一方是安南阮朝，軍隊以京師禁軍與各省鎮戍為骨幹，火器以仿製西式步槍與土砲為主；黑旗軍本為太平天國餘部劉永福所率，受僱於阮朝平定黃旗起義，轉而與法國交戰，一八八四年清廷更派廣西與雲南官軍入越，以提督唐景崧、雲南督辦岑毓英為統帥，黑旗軍受清廷節制，與官軍並肩作戰。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were France on one hand and, on the other, the Nguyễn court of Tonkin together with the Black Flag army hired into its service; as the conflict escalated, the Chinese provincial armies of Guangxi and Yunnan were drawn in as well. On the French side the expedition to Tonkin was built in three tiers. At the top, personnel and supply were controlled jointly by the Colonial Ministry and the War Ministry in Paris; the expeditionary force passed through three commanders in turn, Brière de l'Isle, de Failly and Gallieni, while on the naval side Admiral Courbet, commander of the Tonkin naval division, led the squadron and the river gunboat flotilla. The backbone of the army was made up of French line infantry regiments and the Foreign Legion, supplemented by Algerian colonial infantry, the tirailleurs algériens, and by militia raised among the Annamite population. The artillery train carried quick-firing field guns and heavy pieces for siege work, and supply was transhipped through three bases — Hải Phòng, Saigon and Hanoi — with Cochinchina and Annam in the rear providing food, fodder and shipping. The other side was the Nguyễn dynasty of Annam, whose army rested on the capital garrison and the provincial garrisons, armed mostly with copies of Western rifles and native cannon. The Black Flags, originally the band of Liu Yongfu that had come out of the Taiping rebellion, had been hired by the court to suppress the Yellow Flag rising; they turned instead against France, and in 1884 the Qing court sent the armies of Guangxi and Yunnan into Vietnam, under the command of Governor Tang Jingsong in Guangxi and Cen Yuying in Yunnan, with the Black Flags placed under Qing control and fighting alongside the provincial troops.
people: 關鍵人物分屬三個群體。法軍一方最要緊的是海軍陸戰隊出身的亨利·里維耶：他於一八八二年率分隊攻入河內城，奪取城砦，把法軍第一個據點釘在北圻心臟，一八八三年五月十九日在紙橋被黑旗軍擊斃，成為遠征初期法軍士氣崩潰的轉折點。接任的布里耶·德·伊爾與法伊利兩位將軍只恢復了攻勢，卻仍用縱隊行軍的老辦法；真正改變戰法的是加利尼，他一八八四年五月接任遠征軍總司令後發出「河內訓令」，要求部隊分散成小分隊、把安南人編入作戰序列，結果一年之內連下北寧與河內兩座城砦。黑旗軍與清軍一方，首領是劉永福，他以少數兵力在紙橋與北黎反覆重創法軍，一八八四年冬又據守山西村城砦，把法軍第一次強攻擋了回去；雲南方面有岑毓英率滇軍入越，廣西方面有唐景崧與馮子材在諒山與鎮南關一線與法軍爭鋒。海軍方面，康貝上將率北圻分艦封鎖紅河，並以艦砲射擊河內城砦，掩護陸軍作戰。
peopleEn: The decisive figures fall into three groups. On the French side the most important was Henri Rivière, an officer of the marine infantry: in 1882 he led a detachment into the Hanoi citadel, took it, and fixed the first French foothold in the heart of Tonkin; on 19 May 1883 he was killed by the Black Flags at the Paper Bridge, and that defeat marked the collapse of French morale at the opening of the campaign. Brière de l'Isle and de Failly, who succeeded him, restored the offensive but kept the old habit of marching in column. The man who actually changed the method was Gallieni, who took over the expedition in May 1884 and issued the Hanoi orders, requiring units to disperse into small detachments and to take Annamite troops into the line of battle; within that year Bắc Ninh and the Hanoi citadel both fell. On the Black Flag and Qing side the leader was Liu Yongfu, who with a small force inflicted repeated heavy blows on the French at the Paper Bridge and at Bắc Lệ, and who in the winter of 1884 held the Sơn Tây citadel and turned back the first French assault on it; in Yunnan Cen Yuying led the provincial army into Vietnam, while in Guangxi Tang Jingsong and Feng Zicai fought the French along the Lạng Sơn and Zhennan Pass lines. On the naval side Admiral Courbet blockaded the Red River with the Tonkin division and used the guns of his ships to support the land attack on the Hanoi citadel.
kits: 本卡兵器雷管步槍在這場遠征中既是法軍的標準步兵武器，也是雙方火力差距的核心。法軍步兵主要裝備葛拉夫式一八七四年單發雷管步槍，槍身由聖埃蒂安與克萊蒙費朗等地的兵工廠供應，外籍營與阿爾及利亞土兵同樣配發；遠征初期軍中仍混有少量更舊的滑鎗與火繩槍，通常只配給非戰鬥勤務與地方警戒。射程與精度的提升把交戰距離從白刃推到數百步，遠征初期法軍仍沿用密集縱隊，一遇黑旗軍伏擊便在霧與雨季的叢林裡失去指揮。到一八八六年，法軍換裝勒貝爾式一八八六年八發連發步槍，採用八毫米小口徑，這批新槍正是在遠征末期才大量裝備北圻前線。砲兵方面，法軍有速射野戰砲、七十五毫米與九十毫米山砲，以及一二〇公釐迫擊砲與二十四磅攻城砲，用來封死城砦外的道路與水道；海軍在紅河與寧江上部署的砲艇群與江防汽艇，則以艦砲支援陸軍攻取河內城砦。對面一方，黑旗軍使用雲南製造局仿製的德製毛瑟一八七一年型步槍與改裝舊槍，並有十二磅克虜伯速射砲、仿製山砲與加特林機槍，能在城牆後以曲射火力壓制進攻縱隊；安南官軍與黑旗軍另有大量抬槍與仿明式紅衣大砲，用於守城與封鎖渡口。運輸方面，遠征軍靠西貢與海防的蒸汽船隊、紅河內河航運以及海防至河內的鐵路維持補給，越南人徵召的挑夫與牛車隊構成後方運力。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle of this card was both the standard infantry weapon of the French army and the core of the firepower gap between the two sides. French infantry were mainly armed with the single-shot percussion rifle modèle 1874, the Gras, supplied by arsenals such as Saint-Étienne and Clermont-Ferrand, and the Foreign Legion and the Algerian tirailleurs received the same pattern; a few older smoothbore and flint weapons survived in the early years of the expedition and were normally handed to fatigue parties and local guards. The longer range and the greater accuracy pushed the range of contact from the bayonet to several hundred paces, yet the expedition in its first phase still marched in dense columns, and once the Black Flags ambushed such a column in fog or in the forests of the wet season the chain of command fell apart. By 1886 the French were changing over to the Lebel modèle 1886, an eight-round repeating rifle chambered for an 8 mm cartridge, and it was this new weapon that reached the Tonkin front in quantity only at the very end of the campaign. On the artillery side the French fielded quick-firing field guns, 75 mm and 90 mm mountain guns, 120 mm mortars and 24-pounder siege pieces, used to cut the roads and waterways leading to the citadels; the gunboat flotilla and the river defence steamers on the Red River and the Fleuve Noir supported the army with naval gunfire when the Hanoi citadel was taken. On the other side the Black Flags used rifles copied at the Yunnan arsenals from the German Mauser modèle 1871 together with reworked older weapons, and they had 12-pounder Krupp quick-firing guns, copied mountain pieces and Gatling guns that could put curved fire over the walls onto an attacking column; the Annamite regulars and the Black Flags also kept large numbers of pole-mounted guns and Chinese-type heavy red cannon for the defence of towns and for blocking river crossings. On the logistics side the expedition drew its supplies from the steamer fleets of Saigon and Hải Phòng, from inland navigation on the Red River, and from the railway that ran from Hải Phòng to Hanoi, while Annamite porters and ox-cart teams formed the hauling capacity of the rear areas.
tactics: 遠征初期法軍的戰術可以用一句話概括：以縱隊行軍，以正面接敵。縱隊在紅河三角洲的稻田、樹林與村落之間拉成數公里長，一旦黑旗軍以小股步兵封住道路、從兩側高地射擊，整個縱隊就會被切斷；一八八三年五月的紙橋與北黎兩戰，幾乎都是這樣被打崩的。轉折發生在法軍增兵之後：遠征軍把行軍縱隊縮短為以連為單位的分散隊形，宿營先挖壕、擇地設營，由騎兵與步兵偵察隊在前警戒，砲兵與工程兵跟隨主力一天不過行進二十餘公里，靠沿途設站維持糧秣。攻城方式同樣改觀：法軍不再急著強攻有護城河與鹿砦的方形城砦，而是先用野戰砲與攻城砲封死出入道路與水道，再用海軍砲艇沿江射擊，逼迫守軍耗盡糧彈後投降，一八八四年北寧城砦即在連續廿四小時的炮擊後失守。與此同時，法軍大量使用安南民兵與投降的黑旗舊部擔任前線搬運、警戒與攻堅，逐步把主戰位置讓給安南人與「黑營」部隊。作戰季節同樣決定戰局：北圻五月至十月的雨季、叢林與疫病使任何遠離據點的攻勢代價高昂，遠征軍的傷病減員多過戰鬥減員，因此冬季與旱季反而是法軍唯一能推進的時段。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the French expedition in its opening phase can be summed up in one line: march in column and engage frontally. A column stretched out over several kilometres across the paddy fields, groves and villages of the Red River delta; the moment the Black Flags closed a road with a handful of infantry and fired from the high ground on either flank, the whole column was cut apart, and that is very nearly how the Paper Bridge and Bắc Lệ were lost in May 1883. The turning point came after the reinforcements arrived: the expedition shortened its marching columns into dispersed formations built round a company, dug in and chose a camp before taking the night, and kept cavalry and infantry scouts out in front, while the artillery and engineers followed the main body at a rate of little more than twenty kilometres a day and the rationing points were moved forward along the route. The siege method changed with it. The French no longer rushed the square citadels ringed by a moat and abatis; instead they sealed the roads and waterways with field and siege guns, brought the naval gunboats up the river to shoot, and waited for the garrison to exhaust its food and ammunition. Bắc Ninh fell in exactly that way, after twenty-four hours of continuous bombardment. At the same time the French made heavy use of Annamite militia and surrendered Black Flags for carrying, guard duty and storming parties, and moved the main body of the line gradually onto Annamite and Black Battalion troops. The season mattered as much as the plan: the wet season from May to October, with its forest, its miasma and its disease, made any offensive away from the depots ruinously expensive, and sickness removed more men from the expedition than did the enemy, so that the dry months and the winter were the only windows in which the French could advance.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下，但各方戰報彼此出入，只能當作量級參考。紙橋一戰（一八八三年五月十九日），法軍出動約一千七百人、二十八門砲，黑旗軍約三千人；法方記錄為陣亡一百一十五人、受傷三百零五人，法軍司令里維耶陣亡，殘部退回河內。北黎遭遇戰（五月二十三日至二十四日），法軍僅五百二十人，多為外籍營第三團與海軍陸戰隊的分遣隊，遭廣西官軍數千人包圍，法方公報稱陣亡九十六人、受傷二百零一人，兩名連長陣亡。山西村攻堅（十二月十九日至二十日），法軍出動約八百人，黑旗軍守軍在四千至六千人之間；法軍攻城未果，死傷數百人，守軍本身也消耗不輕。城砦尺度亦有記載：山西村為方形土城，每邊約一千二百公尺，牆高約四公尺，壕寬約六公尺，另設內外兩重土壘。遠征軍總兵力隨增援不斷上升，到一八八四年連同安南人部隊已達一萬五千至兩萬人，海軍北圻分艦有十餘艘砲艦與巡洋艦。遠征三年，非戰鬥減員主要來自霍亂、瘧疾與腳氣病，數目與作戰傷亡相當甚至更高。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly as follows, but the opposing reports differ from one another and can only be taken as an order of magnitude. At the Paper Bridge on 19 May 1883 the French engaged with about 1,700 men and twenty-eight guns against some 3,000 Black Flags; the French record gives 115 killed and 305 wounded, with the commander of the column, Rivière, among the dead, and the survivors fell back on Hanoi. In the action at Bắc Lệ on 23 and 24 May a French column of only 520 men, drawn mostly from the third regiment of the Foreign Legion and a detachment of marine infantry, was surrounded by several thousand Guangxi troops; the French bulletin gives 96 killed and 201 wounded, with two company commanders killed. In the assault on Sơn Tây on 19 and 20 December the French took about 800 men into the attack against a Black Flag garrison numbered between four and six thousand; the assault failed, the French lost several hundred men, and the garrison was itself worn down. The dimensions of the fortification are also on record: Sơn Tây was a square earthwork of roughly 1,200 metres a side, with ramparts about four metres high and a moat some six metres wide, and an inner and an outer line of earthwork inside the wall. The size of the expeditionary force rose steadily with the reinforcements and reached something between 15,000 and 20,000 men by 1884, counting the Annamite troops, and the Tonkin naval division numbered more than a dozen gunboats and cruisers. Over the three years of the campaign the non-battle losses, from cholera, malaria and beriberi, were of the same order as, or even greater than, the losses in action.
cause: 法國要打這場仗，最初並不是為了打仗。一八六〇年代拿下南圻之後，法國商人與外交官看中紅河是通往雲南與中國內陸最短的通道：茶、絲與雲南的錫、鹽若能由海防經紅河直達蒙自，再由雲南鐵路或轎子運到漢口，遠東的商品市場就會多出一條通道。加上北圻阮朝宮廷年年進貢、官府腐敗，巴黎便把安南與北圻視作後院，先後用武力和條約把它變成保護國。直接引爆的導火線是北圻本地的一八八二年黃旗起義，這場以反清反法為名的起義席捲了紅河中游幾個府縣，阮朝請僱傭兵平叛，黑旗軍在平叛中殺害法國傳教士與在越法人，一八八三年法國海軍陸戰隊司令里維耶藉口出兵，攻佔河內城砦。黑旗軍隨即南下反攻，紙橋與北黎兩戰重創法軍，巴黎於是把行動升級為全面遠征，並把要求伸向中國：清廷在北黎受挫後被迫接受一八八四年五月的中法天津簡約，承認法國對北圻的宗主地位，遠征於是從一場地方衝突，變成中法兩國的正式對抗。
causeEn: France did not go into this war in order to fight a war. After taking Cochinchina in the 1860s, French merchants and diplomats set their eyes on the Red River as the shortest road to Yunnan and to the interior of China: if tea, silk and the tin and salt of Yunnan could go from Hải Phòng up the Red River to Móng Cái and then by cart or by the Yunnan railway to Hankou, the Far Eastern market would gain a new route. Added to this, the Nguyễn court in Tonkin paid its tribute every year and its administration was rotten, so Paris came to treat Annam and Tonkin as its backyard, and to convert them into protectorates by force and by treaty. The immediate trigger was the Yellow Flag rising of 1882 in Tonkin, a movement against both Qing and French authority that swept the middle Red River; the court hired mercenaries to put it down, and the Black Flags killed French missionaries and French residents while doing so, so in 1883 Henri Rivière advanced under the pretext of reprisal and seized the Hanoi citadel. The Black Flags then came down to meet him, and the French were badly hit at the Paper Bridge and at Bắc Lệ. Paris answered by turning the operation into a full-scale expedition and by pressing its claims on China: after the defeat at Bắc Lệ the Qing court was compelled to accept the Tientsin Accord of May 1884, recognising French suzerainty over Tonkin, and what had begun as a local quarrel became a formal confrontation between two states.
impact: 這場遠征的結果，是法國在亞洲的版圖最後一次大幅擴張。越南三國——北圻、安南與南圻——自此合成法屬印度支那，一八八六年北圻被正式編為殖民地，一八八七年再由法令把它與安南、交趾支那、柬埔寨合併，直到一九四五年安南宣布獨立、一九五三年柬埔寨獲得獨立，這個殖民框架延續了半個多世紀。對清廷而言，藩屬體系的最後一塊遮羞布被揭掉，雲南從此直接面對紅河對岸的法國邊境，廣西與雲南的邊防軍費大增，敗局也催生了台灣建省的籌議；中法之間的疙瘩一直延到一九四六年前後的關係交涉。對北圻本身，戰役把原本分屬清、越兩套體系的武裝拆散重組：黑旗軍被清廷收編又解散，劉永福率殘部回廣西，後來再赴越南平亂；法軍則把招撫的黑旗降兵編為黑營，收編安南人作安南土兵，逐步用本地兵代替歐洲兵，這是法國在亞洲建立常備殖民軍的開端。在武器史上，這場戰爭也標記了單發雷管步槍的終局：葛拉夫式步槍射程雖長，在雨季叢林裡射速與可靠性卻不勝任，勒貝爾式連發步槍在一八八六年的裝備，才真正改變了法國遠東殖民軍的火力結構。
impactEn: The outcome of this expedition was the last great extension of the French empire in Asia. The three states of Vietnam — Tonkin, Annam and Cochinchina — were joined into French Indochina; Tonkin was formally organised as a colony in 1886, and in 1887 a decree merged it with Annam, Cochinchina and Cambodia, a colonial framework that lasted until Annam declared independence in 1945 and Cambodia followed in 1953, more than half a century. For the Qing court the last fig leaf of the tributary system was stripped away: Yunnan now faced the French frontier across the Red River, the frontier garrisons of Guangxi and Yunnan cost far more to maintain, and the defeat also fed the discussions that led to Taiwan being made a province in 1885. The Chinese resentment of that settlement ran on into the negotiations between China and France around 1946. For Tonkin itself the war broke apart and recomposed the armed forces that had belonged to two different systems, the Qing and the Nguyễn: the Black Flags were taken into the Qing army and then dispersed, Liu Yongfu took the survivors back to Guangxi and returned to Vietnam later to put down another rebellion, while the French enrolled surrendered Black Flags as the Black Battalion, formed Annamite tirailleurs, and steadily replaced European soldiers with local men, which was the beginning of a standing colonial army in Asia. In the history of weapons the campaign also marks the end of the single-shot percussion rifle: the Gras had reach, but in the forests of the wet season its rate of fire and its reliability were not enough, and it was the issue of the Lebel repeating rifle in 1886 that truly changed the firepower of the French army in the Far East.
result: 打完之後，法國拿到了北圻，但並非一次拿到手。一八八四年三月，法軍以連續廿四小時的炮擊加上封鎖，奪下北寧城砦；四月廿五日，紅河砲艇群的艦砲與陸軍野戰砲同時射擊，河內城砦陷落，而阮朝嗣德帝早已退守順化。一八八四年六月法軍攻佔北黎，戰事隨即升級為中法戰爭；十二月至翌年三月，法軍與安南土兵在諒山與老關一線反攻，馮子材部在鎮南關外大破清軍，一八八五年三月關外連戰失利，清廷才在六月九日簽訂天津條約，正式承認法國對北圻的佔領。遠征本身則以一八八六年法國政府把北圻改組為殖民地、一八八七年組成法屬印度支那告終。從軍事上看，這場戰爭的關鍵轉折不是任何一場會戰的勝負，而是法軍放棄正面強攻、改用封鎖與砲兵消耗，加上把作戰主力逐步換成安南人與黑營；從武器上看，換裝連發步槍之前的單發雷管步槍，只能支撐遠距離的單發射擊，一遇上村落、稻田與濕季叢林裡的密集防禦，便顯出射速不足的致命弱點。
resultEn: France had Tonkin in the end, but not in a single stroke. In March 1884 the French took Bắc Ninh after twenty-four hours of continuous bombardment combined with the blockade, and on 25 April the naval guns of the Red River flotilla and the field artillery of the army fired together and the Hanoi citadel fell, the Nguyễn emperor Tự Đức having already withdrawn to Huế. The French occupied Bắc Lệ in June 1884 and the war then escalated into the Sino-French War; from December and into the next March, French columns and Annamite tirailleurs counter-attacked along the Lạng Sơn and Lão Quan lines, and Feng Zicai's troops defeated the Qing army outside Zhennan Pass, the fighting in the pass in March 1885 leaving the Chinese beaten, and only in June did the Qing sign the Treaty of Tientsin on the ninth day of the month, formally recognising the French annexation of Tonkin. The expedition itself closed with the French government's reorganisation of Tonkin as a colony in 1886 and the creation of French Indochina in 1887. Looking at it militarily, the decisive turn in this war was not the outcome of any single battle, but the French abandonment of the frontal assault in favour of blockade and artillery attrition, together with the gradual replacement of the front line by Annamites and the Black Battalion. Looking at it in terms of weapons, the single-shot percussion rifle before the changeover to a repeating arm could only support long-range single shots; once it met the dense defences of villages, paddy fields and wet-season forest, its rate of fire proved a fatal weakness.
